hook.en: Your phone suggests the next word as you type, and a map app finds a route around a traffic jam. Nobody wrote a rule for every case. How does the machine know?

objectives.en: Explain how machine learning uses training and testing data
Give everyday applications of natural language processing

narration.en: Your phone suggests the next word as you type, and a map app finds a route around a traffic jam. Nobody wrote a rule for every case. How does the machine know?

body.en: Emerging trends are new technologies that are expected to change how we live and work. Artificial Intelligence (AI) aims to make machines mimic human intelligence: learning, reasoning and solving problems. Machine Learning (ML) is a part of AI in which a computer learns from data instead of being explicitly programmed with rules. An ML model is built using training data, and its accuracy is then checked with testing data it has not seen. Once accurate, it predicts results for new data, as in spam filters and product recommendations.

points.en: AI: machines that learn, reason and solve problems
ML: learning from data, a subset of AI
Training data builds the model; testing data checks it
Examples: spam filters, recommendations, face unlock

narration.en: Emerging trends are new technologies that are expected to change how we live and work. Artificial Intelligence (AI) aims to make machines mimic human intelligence: learning, reasoning and solving problems. Machine Learning (ML) is a part of AI in which a computer learns from data instead of being explicitly programmed with rules. An ML model is built using training data, and its accuracy is then checked with testing data it has not seen. Once accurate, it predicts results for new data, as in spam filters and product recommendations.
narration.kn: ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ (AI) ಯಂತ್ರಗಳು ಮಾನವ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆಯನ್ನು ಅನುಕರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಯಂತ್ರ ಕಲಿಕೆ (ML) AI ಯ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ; ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಗಣಕಯಂತ್ರ ನಿಯಮಗಳಿಲ್ಲದೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದಿಂದ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ತರಬೇತಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದಿಂದ ಮಾದರಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದಿಂದ ಅದರ ನಿಖರತೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Natural Language Processing (NLP) deals with the interaction between computers and human languages. It lets a computer understand, translate and produce speech and text. Voice assistants, speech-to-text typing, machine translation between languages, spell checkers, predictive typing and chatbots on customer-care websites all use NLP.

narration.en: Natural Language Processing (NLP) deals with the interaction between computers and human languages. It lets a computer understand, translate and produce speech and text. Voice assistants, speech-to-text typing, machine translation between languages, spell checkers, predictive typing and chatbots on customer-care websites all use NLP.
narration.kn: ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಭಾಷಾ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಣೆ (NLP) ಗಣಕಯಂತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವ ಭಾಷೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂವಹನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ. ಧ್ವನಿ ಸಹಾಯಕ, ಭಾಷಾಂತರ, ಕಾಗುಣಿತ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ, ಚಾಟ್‌ಬಾಟ್‌ಗಳು NLP ಬಳಸುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: A college wants software that marks an email as "spam" or "not spam". Describe how machine learning would do it.

steps.en: Collect thousands of old emails already labelled spam or not spam.
Use most of them as training data to build a model that learns patterns in spam.
Check the model's accuracy on the remaining emails (testing data).
Use the trained model to label new incoming emails.

answer.en: Train on labelled emails, test on unseen ones, then classify new emails automatically.
